name: MC - Work Todo Extended Graph Pull
purpose: Synchronize full-fidelity work To Do data through delegated Microsoft Graph calls.

trigger.type: When an HTTP request is received
trigger.security: Tenant authentication when available; otherwise protect and rotate the signed trigger URL.

actions.name: Validate_request
requirements: connectorInstanceId equals the protected environment value
request is within list and payload limits

actions.name: List_delta
actions.url: Use request.listDeltaLink exactly when present; otherwise /v1.0/me/todo/lists/delta.
actions.pagination: Follow every @odata.nextLink and retain the final @odata.deltaLink.
actions.retry: Honor Retry-After for 429 and use bounded retry for transient 5xx responses.

actions.name: Task_delta
actions.url: Use request.taskDeltaLinks[listId] exactly when present; otherwise /v1.0/me/todo/lists/{listId}/tasks/delta.
actions.pagination: Follow every @odata.nextLink and retain the final @odata.deltaLink.
actions.retry: Honor Retry-After for 429 and use bounded retry for transient 5xx responses.

actions.name: Attachment_metadata
actions.constraint: Never fetch or return contentBytes through Scout.

actions.name: Respond
requirements: Return per-collection delta links separately from task data
Mark response complete only after all next links succeed
Do not advance stored delta links until MC acknowledges ingest
On an invalid delta token, return RESET_REQUIRED without a partial payload
